/scripts.value:
on CheckStudyGuide
	// CHECK IF A STUDY GUIDE CAME BACK
	// MADE IT A CUSTOM COMMAND TO GIVE US FLEXIBILITY TO ADJUST THE CHECK AS WE EXPERIENCE DIFFERENT EDGE CASES
	
	switch
		case StudyGuideLastResponseArray["sections"][1]["text"] is not empty
			put "ok" into StudyGuideGenerationResult
			put ArrayToJSON(StudyGuideLastResponseArray) into StudyGuideJSONToSave 
			break
		default
	end switch
end CheckStudyGuide
